pages.text: This chapter covers the in-game starter tutorial. Players who have completed it can skip this page.
Press the $(bold)V key$() (default binding) to enter the top-down town management panel.$(br2)From here, you can survey your terrain and switch sub-modes to plan constructions.
pages.title: Step 1: Open the Management Panel

pages.text: $(li)Press $(bold)1$() to enter building sub-mode.$(li)Select the $(bold)Town Hall$() and place it on the ground.$(li)Build a $(bold)Warehouse$() to store supplies and currency.$(li)Build a $(bold)Crafting Station$() for mages to craft supplies.
pages.title: Step 2: Build Core Buildings
